title: Was useful until it got broken
body:

I tried deleting the alarms but these all appeared back after deleting them. Also the tasks would randomly disappear in the end of the day.

author: valytekiaune

title: A wonderful all-in-one app
body:
I recommend it for anyone who would like to make their life more organised or maybe wants to feel more energetic and productive. The app is free with no ads, but if you want to access all of the features, you will eventuly have to pay (new members get a 50% discount so it costs about 20 eur). A like that its like an all in one of every app from this developer - it has so many features:
Routines
Some workouts
Sleep tracking
Water tracking
Mood tracking
Meditations
Reflection
I think thats everything but maybe i forgot something, i dont remember. 🧐 Just that it has so many features! 
Thank you so much me+, you were making my day better from the first time I opened the app! 🥰🥰🥰🫶🫶🫶
I really recommend this app!!!
